task_groups.title: Implement execute() core: agent creation, event mapping, and token accumulation

subtasks.title: Implement create_deep_agent() call with optional parameter fallback
details: In execute(), call create_deep_agent(model=model, system_prompt=system_prompt, cwd=cwd, tools=_build_af_sdk_tools()).
Do NOT pass permissions parameter.
For thinking: detect 'anthropic:' prefix; if present, attempt create_deep_agent with thinking; use try/except TypeError to silently omit if unsupported.
For max_budget_usd and effort (from **kwargs): attempt to pass each; use try/except TypeError to retry without the parameter and log DEBUG.
Never pass compaction to create_deep_agent.

subtasks.title: Implement astream_events() v2 consumption and event-to-message mapping
details: Iterate async for event in agent.astream_events(..., version='v2').
Wrap each event extraction in try/except KeyError/AttributeError: on failure, log WARNING and continue (skip event).
on_tool_start / on_tool_end: construct and yield ToolUseMessage from payload.
on_chat_model_stream: construct and yield AssistantMessage from text chunk.
on_llm_end: extract token counts (input_tokens, output_tokens) and accumulate into instance variables; yield nothing.
After stream exhaustion: yield terminal ResultMessage with accumulated tokens (None if provider omitted, not 0) and is_error=False.

subtasks.title: Implement permission_callback interrupt mapping
details: Empirically discover the interrupt/resume API from the installed deepagents>=0.5 source.
If permission_callback is not None: register an interrupt hook with create_deep_agent (using the discovered API parameter).
The hook: extract tool_name: str and tool_input: dict from interrupt event payload; call permission_callback(tool_name, tool_input); forward bool to resume interface.
If permission_callback raises: deny the tool call, yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=False), exit generator cleanly.
If permission_callback is None: do not register any interrupt hook (create_deep_agent called without the interrupt parameter).

task_groups.title: Implement execute() error handling, retry logic, and close()

subtasks.title: Implement transient error detection, exponential backoff retry loop
details: Wrap the agent creation + astream_events loop in a retry loop bounded to _MAX_TRANSPORT_RETRIES (3) attempts.
Catch transient errors (connection failures, HTTP 429, provider 5xx); for each, await asyncio.sleep(_BACKOFF_BASE * 2^(attempt-1)) then retry with a fresh create_deep_agent() call.
Discard any partial checkpoint state before retry to avoid duplicate event replay.
After exhausting all retries: yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=True) and return.
No jitter applied; delays are exactly 1.0, 2.0, 4.0 seconds.

subtasks.title: Implement non-transient error handling and no-exception-propagation guarantee
details: Catch non-transient errors (authentication failures, HTTP 401, tool execution errors) immediately: yield ResultMessage(is_error=True, is_transport_error=False) without retry.
Wrap the outermost execute() body in a broad except clause ensuring no exception propagates: all failure modes surface through ResultMessage.
Confirm via TS-03-12 that even unexpected RuntimeError yields a terminal ResultMessage.

subtasks.title: Implement close() method with idempotent LangGraph state release
details: Implement close(): release per-instance LangGraph checkpoint state (set self._checkpointer = None, self._thread_state = None, or equivalent).
Make close() idempotent: guard with 'if already closed, return immediately'.
close() must be synchronous (or a trivial coroutine); it must NOT call asyncio.Task.cancel() or any async cancellation primitive.
When execute() is not running, close() is a no-op returning None.
